description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to enable the living room of Flat 4 to be extended towards the back over the existing flat roof by 2.5m following planning permission 00840/40/P9 dated 02/08/2019 for erection of a part single part two storey rear extension, part first floor side and rear extensions to allow the conversion into five flats with cycle and car parking, bin storage and landscaping  .
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (961/RDP/P01; 961/RDP/P02; 961/RDP/P03
Received:  12 November 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Prior to occupation of the development, details of hard and soft landscape works for the open areas on the site shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The detailed landscaping scheme shall include soft planting (including trees), hard landscaping and hard surfaces, boundary treatments and any children's play equipment.  The works shall then be carried out as approved.
Any planting comprised in the approved details shall be carried out during the first planting and seeding seasons following completion of construction works and the hard surfaces and fencing shall be installed before first occupation of any dwelling. Any trees or shrubs planted (including any such replacements) which die within five years from the date of planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with the same species, and of comparable maturity. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained in accordance with the approved management programme.

Condition : 5 - Prior to occupation of the development, full details (including manufacturer's specifications and means of enclosure) of the cycle parking provision for the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  
The approved details shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout be covered and secure, and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 6 - Prior to occupation of the development, each of the proposed flats shall be provided with a London Borough of Hounslow residual waste black wheeled bin, a food bin and a set of three recycling boxes (red box for metals/ plastics, blue box for card/ paper, green box for glass) as set out on the Council's website https://www.hounslow.gov.uk/info/20128/.  
Thereafter, apart from on relevant collection days, all waste and recycling bins shall be stored only within the approved waste store, or in the case of food bins internally within the approved flats.  The approved waste store shall also be permanently retained in this use.

Condition : 7 - Prior to occupation of the development all rooms within the development that adjoin, oversail or are underneath any other room shall have been tested for compliance with the requirements of Pages 12-15 and 20-56 of Approved Document E of the Building Regulations 2010 for internal separating walls and floors.   If any wall, ceiling or floor fails to meet the requirements, the defect shall be made good and a further test shall be carried out.  All test results shall be submitted to the local planning authority for its approval.  In addition, all door self-closers installed in the building shall be of a 'soft close' type and adjusted to ensure that no doors in the building slam or otherwise transmit percussive noise within the building.
